test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two trains of lengths 110 m and 100 m are running towards each other on parallel lines at the speed of 50 km/h and 58 km/h, respectively. How long will they take to cross each other after they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 110 m

Length of Train 2 = 100 m

Speed of Train 1 = 50 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 58 km/h

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2 (since they are moving towards each other)

Time to cross each other = Total length of trains / Relative speed

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 50 + 58 = 108 km/h

Convert speed to m/s: 108 × (1000/3600) = 30 m/s

Total length of trains = 110 + 100 = 210 m

⇒ Time = 210 / 30

⇒ Time = 7 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
